title: The páramos: the high mountains of Colombia
goal: Describe the páramos and what people ask for to protect them, with relative clauses and the subjunctive (*leyes que protejan*).
grammar: relative clauses with the subjunctive, applied to the páramos

items: I can say what I am looking for or what does not exist with *que* + subjunctive (*Busco un guía que conozca…*).
I can say what the páramos are and why they matter for water.
I can use the new words for the páramo, the frailejón, the mist and the stream.
